name: Charter Hardtip
description: Turn side-on with the point angled low and forward, the stance that every piercing stroke grows from.

name: Harpooning Squaretip
description: Sink into the hips and thrust from a seated stance so the whole leg weight rides behind the point.

name: Drillpounce
description: Crouch beneath the foe's first cut and step inside it with the point already aimed upward.

name: Gust Rigidtang
description: Lock the wrist rigid and let the blade's stiffness turn the foe's strike without bending.

name: Heartening Bracespine
description: Look along the foe's armor for dents, patches and worn straps that mark where the point will go.

name: Tautassault
description: Turn the blade a quarter as it enters so the point bores through layers of mail and padding.

name: Thorndrill
description: Follow the foe's retreating blade with a steady bind that keeps their guard open at the seam.

name: Scything Impale
description: Let the point skid down a curved breastplate into the waiting gap beneath the arm.

name: Rumble Pierce
description: Drive qi the length of the blade so the point wedges open a plate seam under the full weight of a lunge.

name: Hourstrait
description: Fire a rapid line of thrusts at head, chest and flank so a single foe cannot cover all three.

name: Daybreak Trianglespine
description: Rotate the grip until a flat face of the blade sits squarely against the wrist and the point rides true.

name: Raging Squarepoint
description: Thrust with each of the four faces turned in turn to the target, learning how the ridges bite.

name: Gustimpale
description: Place the feet at right angles to each other so the thrust drives straight from the back leg.

name: Murkslender
description: Check a blow with the rigid blade held square, letting its stiffness carry the weight away.

name: Rumble Thrustspine
description: Channel qi along each ridge of the square blade so the thrust opens a narrow path through hard targets.

name: Unbroken Stiffspine
description: Beat the foe's weapon away with a ridge of the blade and recover the point to the centre line.

name: Iron Skewer
description: Spin the blade a quarter-turn as it enters so the four ridges wedge the wound open.

name: Adamant Iron Longtang
description: Fill the blade with qi until it will not bend, then hold it before the body to stop a heavy cut.

name: Hoarfrost Stiffspine
description: Stand with the blade held straight and unwavering, the arm locked behind it like a lance rest.

name: Facet Thrustspine
description: Thrust along a line that never curves, with the wrist, elbow and shoulder fixed in a single bar.

name: Might Stiffblade
description: Advance with each foot planted fully before the next lifts, letting no stumble reach the point.

name: Stiffblade Linctus
description: Check the grip before every exchange and reset the hands until the blade sits level.

name: Equipoise Bracespine
description: Swat the foe's weapon away with a short, stiff flick of the forte and return to the line.

name: Verity Trianglespine
description: Breathe slowly and let the qi field spread to the point so the foe's range is felt.

name: Rumble Rigidtang
description: Lock qi through the whole blade and skewer the target in a thrust that does not flex.

name: Gouge Greave
description: Hold the foe's blade fixed with a stiff cross that no wrist twist can loosen.

name: Scorching Gouge
description: Whip the stiffened blade's flat against the foe's head to daze them before the point follows.

name: Steel Squarepoint
description: Charge straight in with the blade held rigid, so that nothing the foe interposes turns the point.

name: Glint Longtang
description: Meet the foe's thrust on the rigid blade and send its force back along the very same line.

name: Rejuvenating Hardtip
description: Read the join of each plate from the foe's shoulders to the knees while keeping the point levelled.

name: Iron Drill
description: Prod the point into a plate join to test whether the metal gives under pressure.

name: Granite Bore
description: Shuffle sideways past the foe's guard in short steps without lifting the feet from the ground.

name: Iron Squaretip
description: Cover the body behind the blade held across the chest, with the point angled at the foe's throat.

name: Mayhem Pierce
description: Wedge the point into a seam and twist, prying the plates apart so the fastenings strain.

name: Lambasting Skewer
description: Thrust along the line of rivets where the metal is thinnest and the join is weakest.

name: Facet Pierce
description: Thrust at the thin leather lining beneath a plate and tear through where it holds the pieces.

name: Unmaking Stiffblade
description: Drive the qi-hardened point into a loosened seam with the full weight of the body and split it.

name: Rupturing Gouge
description: Hammer a plate edge with the pommel to rattle the wearer's bones and loosen the fastenings.

name: Thorn Bracespine
description: Open with the point on one track and the free hand on the other, both ready to answer.

name: Tempered Drill
description: Thrust twice in a pair, the first to draw the guard and the second to land.

name: Impalesprint
description: Advance in twin steps, the first small and the second long, so the foe misjudges the distance.

name: Chime Squarepoint
description: Parry on the outer track, then shift to the inner track to meet the foe's second blow.

name: Waning Stiffspine
description: Read both tracks of the foe's stance at once and mark which foot carries more weight.

name: Equipoise Hardtip
description: Set the hands apart on the long grip so each can drive or steer the blade alone.

name: Tempered Bore
description: Thrust high and low in a paired beat so the foe's guard can answer only one.

name: Hoarfrost Impale
description: Bind the foe's blade with the forte and slide the point down it along the second track.

name: Hastening Squaretip
description: Retreat along a flowing curve that keeps the point at the foe while the body slips round their flank.

name: Drillplating
description: Show a thrust on the first track, then take the second so the foe's guard moves the wrong way.

name: Impale Barrage
description: Chain a bind-thrust on the first track and a recovery-thrust on the second with no pause between.

name: Tempered Thrustspine
description: Strike the same plate twice in rapid succession so that the second point enters the dent the first made.

name: Irontaut
description: Hold the point raised over the shoulder like a perched hawk, watching for the moment to drop.

name: Drillassault
description: Drop the point from above the shoulder in a steep line onto the foe's collarbone.

name: Bounding Longtang
description: Spring back and up in a light arc, landing out of reach with the point still raised.

name: Unshaken Trianglespine
description: Brush the foe's thrust aside with a light outward sweep, as a wing turns a falling feather.

name: Chimetaut
description: Scan the foe from a height of stance and fix on the one gap that will stay open.

name: Glint Trianglespine
description: Rise onto the toes, then drop body and point together onto the foe's shoulder gap.

name: Hamstringing Skewer
description: Clamp the crossguard down over the foe's blade like a talon and pin it to their side.

name: Glint Bore
description: Gather qi overhead and plunge the point down through the foe's shoulder plate in one swift stoop.

name: Silt Drill
description: Circle the point above the head and drop it in quick stoops at each foe within reach in turn.

name: Slendercloak
description: Stand firm like a bank with the point forward, letting the foe's rush pass along the blade.

name: Rumble Squaretip
description: Follow the direction of the foe's own motion and thrust where their weight is already flowing.

name: Surging Stiffblade
description: Glide in smooth even steps that never pause, as a stream runs over smooth stones.

name: Gusttaut
description: Turn the foe's blade in a small circle so it spins away from the body like a leaf in an eddy.

name: Intent Rigidtang
description: Beat a steady paired rhythm of push and pull with both hands to keep the blade lively.

name: Silt Stiffspine
description: Curve into the foe's flank round the bend of their guard so the point arrives from beside.

name: Fastening Bracespine
description: Join the foe's blade at the cross where two currents meet and hold it from both sides.

name: Facet Hardtip
description: Thrust once along each of two lines in quick succession so both reach the target almost together.

name: Lancing Ponderous Rigidtang
description: Pour a steady stream of thrusts along one line like a rising river, driving the foe back breathless.

name: Waningslender
description: Sink the blade under the foe's thrust like an undertow and sweep it back at its sender.

name: Ironstrait
description: Stand with the feet in a shallow ring and the point at the centre, the foe's approach funnelled in.

name: Facet Bore
description: Drop low from the rim and thrust upward into the centre of the foe's body.

name: Granite Skewer
description: Walk the circle's edge around the foe with the point always turned inward at their centre.

name: Equipoise Thrustspine
description: Sweep the blade in a shallow dish-shaped curve that scoops a blow aside and returns the point.

name: Daybreak Longtang
description: Breathe as still as a basin of clear water so that qi gathers evenly in the sword arm.

name: Verity Thrustspine
description: Feel the foe's movements echo through the qi field like ripples crossing still water.

name: Facet Squarepoint
description: Sink the point deep into the foe's centre and hold it there a heartbeat before withdrawing.

name: Crippling Gouge
description: Turn the bind round the circle's rim until the foe's blade has no direction left to take.

name: Remnant Drill
description: Swirl the point in a slow whirl that draws the foe's eyes before the thrust darts in.

name: Piercetorment
description: Thrust into the foe's centre and draw the point out along a spiral, pulling their guard inward.

name: Silencing Impale
description: Press the point forward and widen the stance into a basin, holding the foe pinned in its hollow.

name: Iron Squarepoint
description: Plant the feet shoulder-wide and lean into the wind, the point steady at the foe's heart.

name: Hollowskewer
description: Exhale as the thrust leaves the guard so the breath and the point arrive together.

name: Pierce Jaunt
description: Cover ground in long, level strides as on the open plateau, never rising on the toes.

name: Murkstrait
description: Beat the foe's weapon aside with a short gust-quick strike of the forte.

name: Vitalslender
description: Speak the line of the oath under the breath and set the grip firm for the first thrust.

name: Renewing Stiffspine
description: Stand utterly still and read the foe's intent from the way the air moves round them.

name: Iron Pierce
description: Thrust with the speed of a rising gale so that the point is gone before the foe can parry.

name: Gyve Skewer
description: Plant the blade across the foe's like a windbreak and hold it there against all their pushing.

name: Gustgouge
description: Slip sideways over level ground in a single smooth step, leaving the foe's thrust to meet only air.

name: Rumble Gouge
description: Lunge on a surge of qi that lifts the body forward like a gale at the back.

name: Intentslender
description: Beat the foe's blade aside on a rising gust of qi and thrust through the gap before it returns.

name: Granite Squaretip
description: Fix the point on a single bearing toward the foe and hold the stance until it is true.

name: Bracespine Onslaught
description: Thrust without letting the point leave its bearing, however much the foe shifts.

name: Soaring Bore
description: Walk forward with the bearing unchanged so the point always faces the same place on the foe.

name: Hardtip Fastness
description: Check the foe's blow with a small turn of the wrist and return the point to its bearing.

name: Hollowpierce
description: Lunge along the bearing so true that the point meets the exact spot it was set upon.

name: Impalecloak
description: Lock the foe's blade against your bearing so their point cannot swing off the line.

name: Glint Stiffblade
description: Send qi down the held bearing and thrust so truly that the point cannot be turned.

name: Enduring Trianglespine
description: Hold the blade on its bearing with qi so every strike is stopped on the unmoving steel.

name: Straitcuirass
description: Stand as if at a cliff's edge with the weight back and the point reaching out over the drop.

name: Heavy Impale
description: Thrust downward from a raised stance, using the height to add weight to the point.

name: Might Rigidtang
description: Place each foot along a single narrow line as on a ridge, keeping the body balanced above.

name: Resilient Longtang
description: Present the blade like a cliff face that every blow glances off and slides down.

name: Intent Bracespine
description: Take short, deep breaths as at altitude to keep the qi bright and the arm light.

name: Squaretip Linctus
description: Cast the senses wide to the horizon and mark any second foe approaching behind the first.

name: Severing Drill
description: Roll the body along the plateau's rim and thrust from the tumble at the foe's unguarded flank.

name: Ponderous Squarepoint
description: Bind the foe's blade crosswise as a crosswind pins a banner against its pole.

name: Mightgouge
description: Dance along the edge of the footing in quick small steps so the foe is drawn toward the drop.

name: Murk Longtang
description: Retreat across open ground as if giving way, then turn and thrust when the foe overreaches.

name: Iron Rigidtang
description: Thrust with qi spread wide across the blade so that the point opens armor as a rift opens stone.

name: Doctrine Stiffblade
description: Run a high thrust, a low thrust and a rising thrust together as if tracing a distant ridge.

name: Aegisslender
description: Stand with the chest uncovered and the point levelled, the posture of one who has sworn not to retreat.

name: Skinning Gouge
description: Thrust straight at the sworn target and refuse to veer, whatever the foe shows.

name: Drillsprint
description: Stretch the lead leg far forward in a swift reach that closes distance in a heartbeat.

name: Murk Hardtip
description: Push the foe's blade aside with a firm, deliberate turn that gives no ground.

name: Vitalstrait
description: Recite the oath on a long breath until the grip and the qi settle together.

name: Piercecuirass
description: Bind the foe's blade out in the open with no cover, trusting the grip alone to hold it.

name: Slendertorment
description: Drive the thrust with the whole weight of a spoken vow so that it will not be turned.

name: Charter Stiffspine
description: Hold the point at a fixed distance from the foe so they cannot step nearer without pain.

name: Keen Thrustspine
description: Charge in the open with qi gathered in the blade and pierce what stands in the sworn line.

name: Thorn Squaretip
description: Hold the blade across the line of the oath with qi so no blow passes it unbroken.
